pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against averaging down or adding volume within 5 pips of an existing losing position; multi-entry scaling is only authorized after the initial trade achieves a minimum +$8.00 floating profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero-entry authorization during the first 120 seconds of 1-minute ATR spikes exceeding 3.5x the 20-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop-lock (breakeven + $2.00 minimum lock) the exact microsecond any position touches +$12.00 floating profit.
